s1.syndrome_frame: Chronic skin condition with pruritus and skin lesions
salient_findings: Erythematous papules and excoriations on the trunk and upper extremities
Scales and fissures on the lower lip
key_facts: Female patient in her early 40s
No other medical history
Topical corticosteroids did not control symptoms
Physical examination revealed erythematous papules and excoriations
Scales and fissures on the lower lip
Normal blood test results including antinuclear antibodies and complement
Normal urine porphyrin analysis
Skin biopsy showed spongiosis and erosions in the epidermis
Nodular lymphocyte infiltrate in the upper and mid dermis
Phototest with solar simulator showed delayed erythema to UV-A

raw.syndrome_frame: Chronic skin condition with pruritus and skin lesions
salient_findings: Erythematous papules and excoriations on the trunk and upper extremities
Scales and fissures on the lower lip
key_facts: Female patient in her early 40s
No other medical history
Topical corticosteroids did not control symptoms
Physical examination revealed erythematous papules and excoriations
Scales and fissures on the lower lip
Normal blood test results including antinuclear antibodies and complement
Normal urine porphyrin analysis
Skin biopsy showed spongiosis and erosions in the epidermis
Nodular lymphocyte infiltrate in the upper and mid dermis
Phototest with solar simulator showed delayed erythema to UV-A

shortlist.label: Chronic actinic dermatitis
shortlist.why_kept: Delayed erythema to UV-A on phototest and chronic pruritus

shortlist.label: Actinic prurigo
shortlist.why_kept: Scales and fissures on the lower lip and history of pruritus

shortlist.label: Polymorphic light eruption
shortlist.why_kept: Phototest showed delayed erythema to UV-A and skin lesions

shortlist.label: Cutaneous T-cell lymphoma
shortlist.why_kept: Nodular lymphocyte infiltrate in the upper and mid dermis on skin biopsy

shortlist.label: Cutaneous B-cell lymphoma
shortlist.why_kept: Nodular lymphocyte infiltrate in the upper and mid dermis on skin biopsy with CD20 positive cells

raw.rationale: The patient's symptoms of generalized pruritus, erythematous papules, and excoriations, along with the phototest results showing delayed erythema to UV-A, are consistent with chronic actinic dermatitis. The skin biopsy results also support this diagnosis, showing spongiosis and erosions in the epidermis and a nodular lymphocyte infiltrate in the dermis.

rejected.label: Actinic prurigo
rejected.why: While actinic prurigo can present with similar symptoms, the patient's lack of response to topical corticosteroids and the presence of a nodular lymphocyte infiltrate on skin biopsy are more suggestive of chronic actinic dermatitis.

rejected.label: Polymorphic light eruption
rejected.why: Polymorphic light eruption typically presents with a more varied and polymorphic rash, and the patient's symptoms and biopsy results are more consistent with chronic actinic dermatitis.

rejected.label: Cutaneous T-cell lymphoma
rejected.why: The skin biopsy results do not show the characteristic atypical lymphocytes or epidermotropism seen in cutaneous T-cell lymphoma.

rejected.label: Cutaneous B-cell lymphoma
rejected.why: While the skin biopsy results show a nodular lymphocyte infiltrate with a germinal center, the lack of other characteristic features such as follicular architecture or BCL-2 positivity makes cutaneous B-cell lymphoma less likely.
